Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/embedded_images_tables.pdf\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{\"pdf_options\":{\"extract_metadata\":true,\"hierarchy\":{\"enabled\":true,\"include_bbox\":true,\"k_clusters\":6}}}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extract(input, config);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).pages());
    }
}
```
